verdict.rationale: Bolna documents AI-generated per-call outputs inside the product: an agent-level call-summary toggle, and LLM-backed extraction categories (name plus model) configured in the Analytics tab. These are AI insights drawn from call data. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, insights aggregated across calls or datasets, any description of summary/extraction quality or depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Call summaries are an agent-level toggle: call_summary_enabled (boolean, off by default) on the agent create and update APIs
POST /agent/{agent_id}/extraction-categories — create a category (name + model) and attach it to an agent
Configure webhooks, call summaries, and extractions for Bolna Voice AI.
